title: Rafael and the Promise
premise: Cyrus Almeida, once the most sought-after wedding planner in the valley, walked away from the profession after a bride's betrayal shattered her faith in vows. Five years later, she runs a modest event-coordination business and has perfected the art of staying small. When her family's reunion at the Almeida vineyard demands she arrive with a partner, she hires Rafael, a quiet carpenter restoring the estate's chapel, to pose as her boyfriend. But Rafael's honesty about his own losses cracks her armor, and by the reunion's final night Cyrus must choose between the safe, invisible life she built and the vulnerable, seen one he offers—forgiving the woman in the mirror just as the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
about_author: Bram Montrose is the pen name of a former hospitality professional who spent a decade behind the scenes of other people's weddings before turning to fiction. Writing from a small coastal town, Montrose crafts romances about people who rebuild themselves out of the ruins of old promises.

chapters.title: The Contract of Small Steps
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV. Five years after abandoning wedding planning, Cyrus receives her mother's summons to the Almeida family reunion, where her cousin's engagement will be celebrated and her single status dissected. In a panic, she approaches Rafael, the carpenter restoring the vineyard chapel, and offers to pay him to play her boyfriend. Emotional beat: guarded desperation masked as practicality.

chapters.title: Rehearsal for a Lie
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Over two weeks of 'rehearsal dates,' Cyrus and Rafael build a convincing backstory—until real details start slipping out. Rafael reveals he lost his fiancée to illness and took the chapel job to finish the vows he never got to say. Cyrus realizes her fake date knows more about love than she does. Emotional beat: intimacy arriving through pretense.

chapters.title: The Toast
chapters.summary: Cyrus's POV, reunion weekend. At the vineyard, the performance goes too well: her mother warms to Rafael, her ex-fiancé appears with his new wife, and by dessert Cyrus's carefully rehearsed story dissolves into truth. When her aunt toasts 'the happy couple,' Rafael takes her hand for real—and her cousin privately begs Cyrus to plan the wedding. Emotional beat: the mask cracking under warmth.

chapters.title: First Harvest
chapters.summary: Alternating POV, climax and resolution. Cornered by the wedding request and her own terror, Cyrus flees to the chapel and finds Rafael finishing its restoration, confessing that the fake contract ended days ago—he stayed because of her. She confronts the woman in the mirror: the planner who stopped believing in promises, including her own. She agrees to plan her cousin's wedding, and at the harvest festival, Rafael asks her to plan a future with him. Emotional beat: forgiveness, then beginning.
